name: Parent Request and Prescriber Order to Administer Medication
description: Before any medication is given at school, the parent submits a written request with the licensed prescriber's written order (student, medication, dose, route, timing, dates).
quote: With the exception of situations described in Sections E and F, before any medication may be administered to a student during school hours, the school principal or nurse must receive a written request from the parent/guardian.
